message.content:
**Allele frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2 allele) in Europeans**

| Population | Allele frequency (C allele) |
|------------|------------------------------|
| Non‑Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **~0.12–0.13** |
| Finnish Europeans (gnomAD v2.1.1) | **~0.10–0.11** |

*Sources*

- gnomAD v2.1.1 (non‑Finnish Europeans): 12 % (≈ 0.12)  
- gnomAD v2.1.1 (Finnish Europeans): 10 % (≈ 0.10)

These figures represent the proportion of chromosomes carrying the C allele at rs7412 in the respective European cohorts. Frequencies can differ slightly between sub‑European populations (e.g., Southern vs. Northern Europe), but the overall range remains roughly 10–13 %.
